rationale: The Latin anchors *excogitare* (to think out/devise) and *perscrutari* (to search thoroughly/scrutinize) alongside *invenire* (to find/discover) point to an active mental or investigative effort to locate or discover something, which aligns best with search.v.01 ("try to locate or discover, or try to establish the existence of"). This sense captures both the cognitive thrust of *excogitare* and the thorough searching of *perscrutari*, rather than the more passive or physical senses in the other candidates.
